Title: Stand-in Critical Hit Emote
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Critical Hit Emote's folder name and
the datablock names the Adventurer's Weapons test for (CritProjectile and its
burst, the crit sounds), so the crits port works with it. It is not the
original Add-On and holds none of its files, and its numbers are its own.
The sounds are generated moments of silence and critical.png a generated
square, so the importer has files to convert.
